mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course (name, credit, semester, teacher_id, class_id) VALUES (#{name}, #{credit}, #{semester}, #{teacherId}, #{classId})
mapper.update: UPDATE course SET name=#{name}, credit=#{credit}, semester=#{semester} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT c.*, u.username AS teacher_name, cl.name AS class_name FROM course c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.teacher_id=u.id LEFT JOIN class cl ON c.class_id=cl.id WHERE c.id=#{id}

SELECT c.*, u.username AS teacher_name, cl.name AS class_name FROM course c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.teacher_id=u.id LEFT JOIN class cl ON c.class_id=cl.id WHERE c.teacher_id=#{teacherId} ORDER BY c.semester DESC, c.name

SELECT c.*, u.username AS teacher_name, cl.name AS class_name FROM course c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.teacher_id=u.id LEFT JOIN class cl ON c.class_id=cl.id WHERE c.class_id=#{classId} ORDER BY c.semester DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO grade (user_id, course_id, score, grade_point, grade_type, semester, remark) VALUES (#{userId}, #{courseId}, #{score}, #{gradePoint}, #{gradeType}, #{semester}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE grade SET score=#{score}, grade_point=#{gradePoint}, remark=#{remark} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT g.*, u.username AS student_name, c.name AS course_name, c.credit AS course_credit FROM grade g LEFT JOIN user u ON g.user_id=u.id LEFT JOIN course c ON g.course_id=c.id WHERE g.course_id=#{courseId} ORDER BY g.score DESC
SELECT g.*, c.name AS course_name, c.credit AS course_credit FROM grade g LEFT JOIN course c ON g.course_id=c.id WHERE g.user_id=#{userId} AND g.grade_type='final' ORDER BY g.semester
